market_name: Will 11 Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether the probability move in the market is persistent or a single wick; compare to Fed funds futures (implied 2026 cuts) for corroboration.
time_plan.1h: Watch 2Y and 10Y yields and TLT price for directional confirmation; check for any macro headline (jobs, CPI, Fed speaker) that already explains the move.
time_plan.2h: Re-assess whether SOFR/fed funds futures repriced dovishly; if not, treat market move as noise.
time_plan.6h: Evaluate whether the bond move held or faded; look for risk-off confirmation across equities and credit.
time_plan.12h: Final check: did TLT close higher with lower yields? Log realized vs expected and whether the market anticipated any public data release.

predictions.reasoning: A market on '11 rate cuts in 2026' (275bps of easing) is a deep-recession / financial-crisis tail. If its implied probability rises sharply, it signals expectations of aggressive Fed easing, which pushes front-end and long-end yields lower and bond prices higher. TLT is the cleanest liquid proxy for a dovish shift in rate expectations.

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Confirm the market move is real and check VIX and equity futures for risk-off tone.
time_plan.1h: Cross-check with credit spreads (HYG/LQD) and USD for a consistent risk-off signal.
time_plan.2h: Determine whether equities are trading the recession fear (down) or the easing hope (up); direction may be mixed.
time_plan.6h: Reassess whether any confirming macro catalyst emerged; downgrade confidence if move is idiosyncratic.
time_plan.12h: Final check on SPY close and whether the dovish tail scenario gained traction in rate futures; log outcome.

predictions.reasoning: Eleven cuts in a single year would only be priced if markets expected a sharp downturn requiring emergency easing. A rising probability of this extreme tail is a risk-off / recession signal, which typically pressures equities lower despite the eventual easing being supportive. The relationship is ambiguous, however, because aggressive easing can also boost stocks (bad-news-is-good-news).

evidence_used: Market question implies 275bps of Fed cuts in 2026, an extreme dovish/recession tail
Fed easing expectations map to bond prices (up), yields (down), and typically risk-off equities
Threshold for 'tradable' is a 700bps 12h move, far above plausible magnitude here
uncertainty_notes: 11 cuts is a very low-probability tail; small probability changes carry little clean information
Equity direction is genuinely ambiguous — recession fear (down) vs easing stimulus (up)
No headline catalyst identified; the market move could be pure noise or thin liquidity
Mislabeled topic ('military_conflict') suggests metadata is unreliable

llm_justification.summary: This is an extreme-tail Fed easing market (11 cuts = 275bps in 2026), essentially a recession/crisis scenario. A sharp rise in its implied probability would signal expectations of aggressive Fed easing: bullish long Treasuries (TLT up, yields down) and generally risk-off for equities (SPY down), though the equity link is ambiguous. Magnitudes are far below the 700bps tradable threshold, so this is a low-confidence, non-tradable research mapping.
key_assumptions: A probability move in this market reflects genuine repricing of Fed easing expectations, not liquidity noise
Rate expectations transmit to Treasury and equity ETFs within the 12h window
No dominant offsetting macro catalyst overwhelms the signal
failure_modes: The move is noise in a thin, deep-tail market with no information content
The easing expectation was already public via fed funds futures, so no fresh signal
Equities rise instead of fall (bad-news-is-good-news easing rally), breaking the risk-off mapping
Magnitude is far below the 700bps tradable bar, so no actionable signal even if direction is right
Proxy exposure is diffuse — many factors drive TLT/SPY beyond this one probability
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
